name: JRDB Edge Parquet completion audit via Issue

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  issues: write

concurrency:
  group: jrdb-edge-parquet-completion-audit
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  audit:
    if: >-
      github.event.issue.user.login == 'yukki0113' &&
      startsWith(github.event.issue.title, '[JRDB_EDGE_PARQUET_COMPLETION_AUDIT]')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 1

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Parse request
        env:
          ISSUE_BODY: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          import json, os, re
          from pathlib import Path
          req=json.loads((os.environ.get('ISSUE_BODY') or '').strip())
          required={
            'feature_run_id','feature_artifact_name','registry_run_id','registry_artifact_name',
            'registry_source_run_id','registry_source_artifact_name',
            'v02_serving_sha256','v03_run_id','v03_artifact_name','v03_catalog_sha256'
          }
          missing=sorted(required-set(req))
          if missing:
              raise SystemExit(f'missing required fields: {missing}')
          for k in ('feature_run_id','registry_run_id','registry_source_run_id','v03_run_id'):
              if not isinstance(req[k],int) or req[k] <= 0:
                  raise SystemExit(f'{k} must be positive integer')
          for k in ('v02_serving_sha256','v03_catalog_sha256'):
              if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}',str(req[k]).lower()):
                  raise SystemExit(f'invalid {k}')
          Path('/tmp/request.json').write_text(json.dumps(req,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
          PY

      - name: Install storage dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -q -r tools/data-storage/requirements.txt

      - name: Export request env
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY' >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          import json
          r=json.load(open('/tmp/request.json'))
          for k,v in r.items():
              if isinstance(v,(str,int)):
                  print(f"{k.upper()}={v}")
          PY

      - name: Download accepted artifacts
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p /tmp/feature /tmp/registry /tmp/registry-source /tmp/v03 /tmp/audit
          gh run download "$FEATURE_RUN_ID" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --name "$FEATURE_ARTIFACT_NAME" --dir /tmp/feature
          gh run download "$REGISTRY_RUN_ID" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --name "$REGISTRY_ARTIFACT_NAME" --dir /tmp/registry
          gh run download "$REGISTRY_SOURCE_RUN_ID" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --name "$REGISTRY_SOURCE_ARTIFACT_NAME" --dir /tmp/registry-source
          gh run download "$V03_RUN_ID" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --name "$V03_ARTIFACT_NAME" --dir /tmp/v03

      - name: v0.2 and v0.3 regression hash gates
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          import hashlib,json,os
          from pathlib import Path
          def sha(p):
              h=hashlib.sha256()
              with p.open('rb') as f:
                  for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):
                      h.update(chunk)
              return h.hexdigest()
          serving=list(Path('/tmp/registry').glob('**/edge_serving_catalog.jsonl'))
          if len(serving)!=1:
              raise SystemExit(f'expected one serving catalog, found {serving}')
          serving_sha=sha(serving[0])
          if serving_sha != os.environ['V02_SERVING_SHA256']:
              raise SystemExit(f'v0.2 serving regression: {serving_sha}')
          matches=[]
          expected=os.environ['V03_CATALOG_SHA256']
          for p in Path('/tmp/v03').glob('**/*'):
              if p.is_file() and sha(p)==expected:
                  matches.append(str(p))
          if len(matches)!=1:
              raise SystemExit(f'v0.3 catalog regression hash not uniquely found: {matches}')
          Path('/tmp/audit/regression.json').write_text(json.dumps({
            'status':'PASS',
            'V02_STANDARD_REGRESSION':'PASS',
            'v02_serving_sha256':serving_sha,
            'V03_SHADOW_REGRESSION':'PASS',
            'v03_catalog_sha256':expected,
            'v03_matching_file':matches[0],
            'scientific_semantics_changed':False,
          },indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
          PY

      - name: Build temporary Feature Mart compatibility SQLite
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY'
          import sqlite3
          from pathlib import Path
          import pyarrow as pa
          import pyarrow.parquet as pq
          matches=list(Path('/tmp/feature').glob('**/edge_runner_fact.parquet'))
          if len(matches)!=1:
              raise SystemExit(f'expected one Feature Mart parquet, found {matches}')
          parquet=matches[0]
          out=Path('/tmp/feature_compat.sqlite')
          if out.exists(): out.unlink()
          pf=pq.ParquetFile(parquet)
          schema=pf.schema_arrow
          def sqltype(t):
              if pa.types.is_integer(t) or pa.types.is_boolean(t): return 'INTEGER'
              if pa.types.is_floating(t) or pa.types.is_decimal(t): return 'REAL'
              if pa.types.is_binary(t) or pa.types.is_large_binary(t): return 'BLOB'
              return 'TEXT'
          q=lambda s:'"' + str(s).replace('"','""') + '"'
          cols=[f'{q(f.name)} {sqltype(f.type)}' for f in schema]
          conn=sqlite3.connect(out)
          try:
              conn.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=OFF')
              conn.execute('PRAGMA synchronous=OFF')
              conn.execute('PRAGMA temp_store=MEMORY')
              conn.execute('CREATE TABLE edge_runner_fact ('+','.join(cols)+')')
              names=[f.name for f in schema]
              insert='INSERT INTO edge_runner_fact VALUES ('+','.join(['?']*len(names))+')'
              conn.execute('BEGIN')
              for batch in pf.iter_batches(batch_size=2000):
                  columns=[batch.column(i).to_pylist() for i in range(batch.num_columns)]
                  rows=zip(*columns)
                  conn.executemany(insert,rows)
              conn.commit()
          finally:
              conn.close()
          print(out.stat().st_size)
          PY

      - name: Locate Registry source SQLite
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mapfile -t registries < <(find /tmp/registry-source -type f -name edge_registry.sqlite -print)
          test "${#registries[@]}" -eq 1
          cp "${registries[0]}" /tmp/registry_source.sqlite

      - name: Write shared benchmark configs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          feature_parquet=$(find /tmp/feature -type f -name edge_runner_fact.parquet -print -quit)
          registry_def=$(find /tmp/registry -type f -name edge_definition.parquet -print -quit)
          cat > /tmp/feature_benchmark.yaml <<YAML
          dataset:
            name: edge_feature_mart_v02
          source:
            format: sqlite
            path: /tmp/feature_compat.sqlite
            table: edge_runner_fact
          target:
            format: parquet
            path: $feature_parquet
            compression: zstd
            partition_by: []
          keys:
            canonical: [race_key, horse_no]
          sort_by: [race_date, race_key, horse_no]
          validation:
            require_unique_key: true
            require_row_count_match: true
            non_null_columns: [race_key, horse_no]
            range_columns: []
          audit:
            path: /tmp/audit/feature_validation.json
          benchmark:
            repeats: 3
            modes: [warm, cold]
            sources:
              - {name: sqlite, engine: sqlite, path: /tmp/feature_compat.sqlite, table: edge_runner_fact}
              - {name: parquet_zstd, engine: parquet, path: $feature_parquet}
            queries:
              - name: full_scan
                sql: SELECT count(*) FROM {table}
              - name: year_filter
                sql: SELECT count(*) FROM {table} WHERE race_date >= '2020-01-01' AND race_date < '2021-01-01'
              - name: pre_race_eligible
                sql: SELECT count(*) FROM {table} WHERE is_pre_race_eligible = 1
              - name: horse_aggregation
                sql: SELECT horse_id, count(*) AS n FROM {table} GROUP BY horse_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100
              - name: sire_aggregation
                sql: SELECT sire_name, count(*) AS n FROM {table} GROUP BY sire_name ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 100
              - name: course_aggregation
                sql: SELECT venue_code, count(*) AS n FROM {table} GROUP BY venue_code ORDER BY n DESC
          YAML

          cat > /tmp/registry_benchmark.yaml <<YAML
          dataset:
            name: edge_registry_v02
          source:
            format: sqlite
            path: /tmp/registry_source.sqlite
            table: edge_definition
          target:
            format: parquet
            path: $registry_def
            compression: zstd
            partition_by: []
          keys:
            canonical: [edge_id]
          sort_by: [edge_id]
          validation:
            require_unique_key: true
            require_row_count_match: true
            non_null_columns: [edge_id]
            range_columns: []
          audit:
            path: /tmp/audit/registry_validation.json
          benchmark:
            repeats: 5
            modes: [warm, cold]
            sources:
              - {name: sqlite, engine: sqlite, path: /tmp/registry_source.sqlite, table: edge_definition}
              - {name: parquet_zstd, engine: parquet, path: $registry_def}
            queries:
              - name: registry_read
                sql: SELECT count(*) FROM {table}
              - name: family_filter
                sql: SELECT count(*) FROM {table} WHERE family IS NOT NULL
              - name: anchor_type_aggregation
                sql: SELECT anchor_type, count(*) AS n FROM {table} GROUP BY anchor_type ORDER BY anchor_type
              - name: status_aggregation
                sql: SELECT status, count(*) AS n FROM {table} GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
          YAML

      - name: Run shared storage benchmark
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: tools/data-storage
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python -m data_storage benchmark /tmp/feature_benchmark.yaml --output /tmp/audit/feature_benchmark.json
          python -m data_storage benchmark /tmp/registry_benchmark.yaml --output /tmp/audit/registry_benchmark.json
          python - <<'PY'
          import json
          from pathlib import Path
          feature=json.load(open('/tmp/audit/feature_benchmark.json'))
          registry=json.load(open('/tmp/audit/registry_benchmark.json'))
          Path('/tmp/audit/result.json').write_text(json.dumps({
            'status':'PASS',
            'benchmark':'PASS',
            'feature_benchmark':feature,
            'registry_benchmark':registry,
            'regression':json.load(open('/tmp/audit/regression.json')),
          },ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
          PY

      - name: Upload completion audit
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: jrdb-edge-parquet-completion-audit-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: /tmp/audit/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
          compression-level: 6

      - name: Comment success and close
        if: success()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import json,os,subprocess
          data=json.load(open('/tmp/audit/result.json'))
          compact={
            'status':'PASS',
            'stage':'EDGE_PARQUET_COMPLETION_AUDIT',
            'run_id':int(os.environ['RUN_ID']),
            'artifact_name':f"jrdb-edge-parquet-completion-audit-{os.environ['RUN_ID']}",
            'V02_STANDARD_REGRESSION':data['regression']['V02_STANDARD_REGRESSION'],
            'V03_SHADOW_REGRESSION':data['regression']['V03_SHADOW_REGRESSION'],
            'benchmark':'PASS'
          }
          body='JRDB_EDGE_PARQUET_COMPLETION_AUDIT_RESULT\n'+json.dumps(compact,indent=2,sort_keys=True)
          subprocess.run(['gh','issue','comment',os.environ['ISSUE_NUMBER'],'--repo',os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY'],'--body',body],check=True)
          subprocess.run(['gh','issue','close',os.environ['ISSUE_NUMBER'],'--repo',os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY'],'--reason','completed'],check=True)
          PY

      - name: Comment failure
        if: failure()
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.issue.number }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          gh issue comment "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"             --body "Edge Parquet completion audit failed closed. Canonical Drive data is not modified by this workflow. Inspect run $GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$RUN_ID."
